topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Hey, I just found out about your transfer! Can you believe it? I mean, honestly, one minute you're right here, and the next, they’re moving you over to a whole new department. What’s the deal with that? I hope this means big things for you, seriously. You deserve all the good stuff. It’s just gonna feel weird not having you around, you know? But hey, we’ll make it work, no question. We have to catch up soon, and you’ll have to tell me everything about your new gig. I hope it’s amazing!
